info.description: Version 1.1 of Fugu Ultra, Sakana AI's multi-agent orchestration model, upgraded to orchestrate newer frontier models with gains of up to 7.9 points over v1.0. Pinned version; fugu-ultra now points to v2.0. Supports three distinct reasoning efforts: high, xhigh and max (a separate maximum level for the hardest problems).

zh.description: Fugu Ultra 1.1 版，Sakana AI 的多智能体编排模型，升级为编排更新的前沿模型，相比 v1.0 最多提升 7.9 分。这是固定版本；fugu-ultra 目前指向 v2.0。支持 high、xhigh、max 三个独立的思考档位（max 是面向最难问题的单独最高档）。
